key_concepts: Tropical cyclone is the general term for cyclones originating over tropical oceans
Typhoons are tropical cyclones with wind speeds of 118-184 km/h
Tropical depression, tropical storm, typhoon, and super typhoon are categories based on wi
Warm ocean water and evaporation supply energy and moisture for typhoon formation
Water vapor condenses to form clouds and precipitation in tropical cyclones
The eye is the calm center with the lowest air pressure
The eyewall surrounds the eye and has the strongest winds and rains
Inner and outer rainbands produce rain at increasing distances from the center
Storm surge is a temporary rise in sea level caused by strong winds and low pressure
The Philippines is prone to tropical cyclones because it lies in the Pacific typhoon belt
Landmasses and bodies of water can weaken or strengthen typhoons
